material.description: U.S. Geological Survey, Water Science School, “What is Hydrology?”, section “What is Hydrology?”, paragraph beginning “There are many pathways the water may take”: the page describes rainfall/snowfall, return to the atmosphere, river flow to the sea, infiltration into soil, evaporation, transpiration and groundwater storage. These examples directly support the listed pathways; the Claim is not intended as an exhaustive classification.
